verdict.rationale: Wise's own API does not document a dedicated accounting API. The closest first-party capability is the Balance Statement API, which retrieves account statements in accounting-friendly formats (CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF). That covers only read access to statement data, not management of accounting records. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API (ledger, categorisation, reconciliation or invoice objects), ability to manage or write accounting data, documented accounting-software sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API

citations.quote: Statements can be retrieved in multiple formats: JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, or QIF.
